n43d8f2afc9.headline: GRA-SML deal: Government already has robust systems to monitor petroleum revenue – CBOD CEO
n43d8f2afc9.summary: The chief executive of the Chamber of Bulk Oil Distributors said Ghana already has robust systems to monitor petroleum revenue. He raised concerns about the resumption of Strategic Mobilisation Limited's monitoring role.
n43d8f2afc9.why: Petroleum revenue monitoring affects how government income from the downstream oil sector is verified, which matters to fuel importers and investors in Ghana's energy market.

n0f906ff93b.headline: Thailand Thanks UAE Sending Key Suspect in $402 Million STARK Fraud Case
n0f906ff93b.summary: The Thai government thanked UAE officials for extraditing the main suspect in the STARK stock fraud case, which affected 4,704 victims and caused $402 million in losses.
n0f906ff93b.why: Large stock fraud cases affect investor confidence and the enforcement environment for securities markets in Thailand.

n4df24719f1.headline: Orange prices continue to rise in Brazil
n4df24719f1.summary: Orange prices in Brazil keep rising due to low availability for the fresh market, despite a drop in demand, according to CEPEA researchers.
n4df24719f1.why: Rising orange prices affect agricultural commodity markets and consumer inflation in Brazil, influencing related sectors and export dynamics.
